title: Viewport edge-case cleanup and browser quirk log for UI kit tokens & components
creator: Marisol Vega
description: Audit and remediate viewport-related visual regressions and browser-specific quirks across the UI kit. Focus areas: token scaling (spacing/typography), buttons (hit area and overflow), table column wrapping, and small-chart rendering on Safari iOS and Firefox desktop. Produce a prioritized bug log, PRs for fixes, and a QA checklist for future regressions.
acceptance_criteria: All P0/P1 visual regressions reproduced with clear reproduction steps and screenshots recorded
Fix PRs opened for each P0 item with design review from the design lead
Updated tokens and component stories that include responsive edge-cases (<=320px and dynamic font-scale) added to Storybook
Cross-browser smoke tests documented and added to the regression suite (manual + Cypress snapshot targets)
reproduction_steps: 1) Load the UI kit story for the component in Storybook on target browser (Safari desktop/macOS, Safari iOS, Firefox desktop latest channel)
2) Set viewport widths: 320px, 375px, 414px, 768px and also test with browser zoom 110% and macOS text size increase
3) Toggle system font scaling (iOS accessibility larger text) where applicable
4) Capture screenshots and a short screen recording focused on the token-driven spacing and button overflow behaviors
5) Record console errors and any CSS warnings; attach to the ticket
affected_components: Table component (column wrapping & header sticky behavior)
Micro charts (sparkline, bar micro-chart) rendering on retina & iOS Safari
Form controls in narrow containers (labels collapsing)
fixes_proposed: Normalize token imports: prefer --rdw-spacing-xs etc. and add clamp() fallbacks for Safari where calc() nesting causes rounding issues
Button: increase min-inline-size and apply text-overflow with aria-label fallback; add explicit touch-target padding for iOS
Table: replace CSS sticky header fallback for Firefox with position: -webkit-sticky + JS polyfill only where overflow context is complex
Charts: force subpixel alignment via transform: translateZ(0) and set preserveAspectRatio on svgs; add high-DPI canvas scaling for sparkline fallback
